output.meaning: sigmoid score for DR present, in [0, 1]

threshold_source: default 0.5, not yet calibrated (scripts/calibrate_threshold.py writes the calibrated value once hold-out predictions exist)
architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet weights, frozen) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dropout(0.3) -> Dense(64, relu) -> Dropout(0.2) -> Dense(1, sigmoid); Adam lr 1e-4; class weights; early stopping on validation loss; SEED 42 (verified in notebooks/model_notebook.ipynb)

training.dataset: Kaggle ascanipek/eyepacs-aptos-messidor-diabetic-retinopathy (EyePACS + APTOS 2019 + Messidor-2 redistribution, pre-augmented, no patient identifiers)
training.run: notebooks/model_notebook.ipynb trains for 8 epochs on a StratifiedGroupKFold split (188,936 train / 47,234 validation) and saves dr_screening_model.h5 and .tflite; its validation metrics at 0.5 were accuracy 0.790, precision 0.920, recall 0.542, F1 0.682. Whether the shipped files are that run is checked by notebooks/kaggle_holdout_eval.ipynb (pending).
training.licence_note: Underlying data is for non-commercial / academic use; no images are stored in this repository.
training.export: model.tflite is about 2.6 MB (quantized export); its scores differ from model.h5 by up to 0.034 on test inputs

metrics.evaluation_set: validation fold from the training notebook (not an independent hold-out)

metrics_status: validation results from the training notebook, not an independent hold-out: 47,234 images, threshold 0.5; does NOT meet the 85% sensitivity target (sensitivity 0.542)
limitations: Screening support only. Not a diagnosis and not clinically validated.

No independent hold-out evaluation: the reported figures are validation results from the training notebook, and at threshold 0.5 sensitivity (0.542) is below the 85% target, so many DR cases would be missed.
The dataset has no patient identifiers, so splits are image-level and any future metric is an optimistic estimate.
The dataset contains augmented near-duplicates; leakage between training and evaluation images cannot be ruled out.
No external evaluation; images from low-cost smartphone fundus lenses were never tested.
The 1-5 severity band is estimated from a binary score by a configurable policy; it is not an ICDR grade.
